selection_reason: CCP-08 completed_verified on application PR #294, so strict CCP order selects CCP-09 — Habitats, Herds, Stables, Kennels & Facility Operations next without starting it.
required_inputs: canonical creature/species habitat, care and capability owners
objective: Execute CCP-09 — Habitats, Herds, Stables, Kennels & Facility Operations. Define source/profile-aware habitat, group-housing and husbandry/facility-operation reference seams without inventing universal habitat suitability, stocking density, facility capacity, upkeep, cost or herd-behavior formulas and without duplicating creature, facility, economy, relationship or world state.

acceptance_profile.scope: Represent habitat requirements, herd/group housing, stable/kennel/facility references and husbandry/service operations only where supported by source/profile evidence.
acceptance_profile.welfare: CCP-05 care/welfare and source biology requirements remain authoritative; facility assignment cannot erase individual needs or agency.
acceptance_profile.facility_authority: Existing Item/facility/asset owners retain facility identity, capacity and condition; CCP-09 references rather than creates a second facility ledger.
acceptance_profile.economy_operations: Economy/logistics owners retain costs, inventory, staffing and throughput; no universal upkeep, labor, capacity or productivity formula.
acceptance_profile.social_boundary: Group/herd compatibility and behavior remain source/profile and later CCP-10 ecology/social-behavior governed; no universal herd behavior or stocking-density rule.
acceptance_profile.later_tranches: CCP-10 retains ecology/social behavior/lifecycle/world integration; CCP-11 retains content/search/workbench/final proof.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused CCP-09 verifier plus exact-head repository health and governed Linux/Windows deterministic Validation Core must pass before merge.
